owner_report.measurement_limits: OUTPUT interpreted in prior adapter/harness numbering, not physical flash numbering. Fresh lead baseline, meter mode/range, residual DC and actual adapter attachment not separately reported.

interpretation: New bench supply availability supersedes the November 1 no-bench-supply state; earlier observations remain historical.
Reported paths are consistent with established ground/VCC mapping. They do not measure VCC-to-ground resistance or establish load current, isolation, signal mapping or a safe 200 mA operating point.
J2507-8 maps to physical pin 2/VCC on both U2900 and U2901; J2507-2 maps to physical pin 10/VSS on both. This is a shared board supply, not verified flash-only isolation.
Prior source 1.793 V / board 0.423 V through measured 99 ohms implies about 13.8 mA only at that operating point; no extrapolation to 1.8 V load current.
Pi GPIO uses 3.3 V logic; the bench supply does not replace signal-level translation. The existing adapter has a regulator and translator; external supply must not be paralleled with its OUTPUT 8.

next_preparation.prerequisites: Identity and listed power/cable/coin-cell/Pi USB-C isolation confirmed. Preserve that state. Before handling confirm J2507-8 to 2 residual 0 V. Remove all Pi/adapter/CH341A-to-board paths, old parallel supply connections and any RESET resistor/ground connection. Keep RESET grabber free. No native router power; assembly/cooling state not newly restated.
next_preparation.first_topology: Supply-only: bench negative -> J2507-2/GND; bench positive -> existing isolated/measured nominal 100-ohm (previously 99-ohm) resistor -> J2507-8/VCC. Use separate breadboard strips for resistor legs. Clip may remain physically seated with entire cable/adapter connection electrically disconnected and free contacts insulated. All adapter/Pi/CH341A paths absent; U2901 RESET lead free.
next_preparation.settings: Jesverty OUT OFF, CHG and OPN disabled; normal voltage preset 1.80 V and normal current-limit preset 0.020 A. In separate OCP screen set 0.020 A and enable OCP. Keep series resistor for first comparison; 20 mA is a cautious diagnostic starting setting, not established safe/adequate operating current. With 99 ohms, ideal branch limit at 1.8 V is about 18.2 mA.
next_preparation.pending_measurements: The first loaded comparison tripped OCP immediately at confirmed 0.020 A normal limit and OCP. A/B/current/stability remain unreported. Hold off; next check is zero residual DC, lead baseline and loose positive supply-lead tip to J2507-8 resistance, approximately 100 ohms expected. No powered repeat or current increase selected.
next_preparation.later_spi: Complete Pi/adapter/target wiring and power sequencing remain unqualified. Need stable loaded target rail within 1.7-2.0 V, understood load and a verified supply separation/translation arrangement before SPI. No automatic resistor bypass, current increase, RESET assertion or read.

performed_by_agent: Read-only local evidence/reference review and repository documentation only. No SSH, serial, GPIO, SPI, supply command, flash acquisition/write or router test.

owner_followup.adapter: Owner confirms prior use of the 1.8 V adapter, believes new supply removes need for it. Clarified that Pi 3.3 V SPI still needs 1.8 V translation; supply can replace target power only.

findings: Voltage resolution 0.01 V, current resolution 0.001 A; display accuracy 0.5% + 5 digits. This is not a calibrated low-current measurement of the target.
Normal A-COARSE/A-FINE settings govern CV/CC crossover; OCP screen separately adjusts trip point and enable state. OCP trips output off.
Output uses red positive and black negative. Green GND is a separate grounding terminal. Do not substitute it for output negative.
Manual presents automatic output OPN and battery-charge CHG modes; leave both disabled for this preparation.
manufacturer_manual_review.limitations: Manual does not establish connected board current, startup overshoot at 1.8 V or safe current injection into this shared rail.

assembly_report.accepted: Supply-only resistor wiring reported assembled per preceding instructions, with OUT off. Prior chassis/isolation confirmation retained.

Otherwise, with OUT off unplug both board leads at the supply terminals, leaving board/breadboard assembly intact; meter in DC volts with leads in COM and V/ohm, measure directly red supply + to black supply - during one unloaded OUT-on check, then OUT off and report reading. No board energization selected.

unloaded_supply_result.endpoints: Jesverty red + to black - terminals, in response to explicit unloaded multimeter-check question.
unloaded_supply_result.interpretation: Consistent with nominal 1.8 V. This is an unloaded DC result, not a loaded board voltage, current-limit test or transient qualification.
unloaded_supply_result.present_state: Owner reports supply-only wiring assembled and output not enabled with board connected; prior isolation retained.
selected_next_test: Keep Pi/adapter/CH341A disconnected, router native sources/cables/coin-cell removed, U2901 RESET lead free; retain nominal 100-ohm series resistor.

With OUT off verify normal voltage preset 1.80 V, normal current limit 0.020 A and separate OCP trip 0.020 A enabled, CHG/OPN off. Meter leads COM and V/ohm, DC volts; confirm J2507-8 to 2 residual approximately 0 V before test.
Fix black meter lead at J2507-2 ground. Enable only Jesverty OUT once. After about five seconds measure A: source-side resistor leg to J2507-2; then B: board-side resistor leg/J2507-8 to J2507-2.
Record supply current display and CV/CC indication, or OCP alarm if it trips. Turn OUT off after readings and report A/B/current/mode/stability.

If A exceeds 2.0 V, unexpected board activity/warming occurs or OCP trips, switch/leave OUT off and report; no restart or setting increase. A low B is a diagnostic result with the resistor, not a reason to bypass it.
unloaded_supply_result.not_performed: No new powered board observation or SPI/read/write. Loaded results remain pending.
unloaded_supply_result.trial_outcome: Superseded pending status: owner subsequently reports immediate OCP at confirmed normal current limit/OCP 0.020 A. See ocp_trip_result; no loaded numeric voltage/current supplied.

ocp_trip_result.owner_report: At 0.02 A the supply immediately goes into OCP; asks whether 0.02 A rather than 0.2 A was intended.
ocp_trip_result.settings_confirmation: Owner explicitly confirms both normal current limit and separate OCP setting are 0.020 A.
interpretation: 0.020 A = 20 mA was the selected initial diagnostic setting; 0.2 A = 200 mA is not selected.

For a steady 1.807 V source and a truly series 99-ohm resistor, ideal maximum passive branch current is 1.807/99 = approximately 18.3 mA, even with a short beyond the resistor. This calculation does not bound unmeasured supply transients or establish actual OCP threshold accuracy.
Immediate OCP does not identify board demand at 1.8 V, prove a damaged chip or justify 200 mA. Actual series/bypass wiring and supply startup/protection behavior remain unresolved.
Earlier 1.807 V remains the unloaded DC measurement. No loaded A/B/current or CV/CC values supplied; do not reinterpret the trip as a measured current.
ocp_trip_result.hold: Leave OUT off; do not repeatedly enable output, raise voltage/current/OCP, bypass resistor or connect Pi. Output trip is reported; physical supply-terminal disconnection not yet confirmed.
next_unpowered_check: With OUT off, switch bench supply off and unplug both board leads at its output terminals; leave the board/breadboard wiring otherwise intact. Pi/adapter/CH341A stay disconnected and native router sources/coin-cell remain absent.
Meter leads COM and V/ohm, DC volts first: confirm approximately 0 V at J2507-8 to J2507-2 and at the loose positive supply-lead tip to J2507-2 before selecting ohms.

Record probes-together lead baseline. In ohms, measure from the loose positive supply-lead tip (the end removed from supply +) to J2507 pin 8. This tests the complete new series path with the resistor still installed.

Expected approximately 100 ohms, based on earlier isolated resistor 99 ohms; near zero suggests a resistor bypass/wrong node, OL suggests an open path. Report actual value and baseline; leave unpowered.
